title: OpenStax ties preschool pretend play to thinking in symbols
summary: OpenStax says children about 3 to 5 years old enjoy pretend play and invent characters because they can think symbolically.
body: The lifespan chapter says preschool-age children, 3 to 5 years old, can think symbolically, so they enjoy pretend play and invent elaborate characters and scenarios. The reason given is symbolic thought, not a checklist percent. CDC separately lists object substitution around 30 months and role play around 4 years. This card is the textbook's link between symbols and pretend, and it is not a screen. The book does not claim every child invents long scenarios on a birthday.

sources.title: OpenStax Psychology

sources.note: Paraphrase only, no quotation. OpenStax Psychology web chapter at /books/psychology/, credited as the first-edition path (CC BY 4.0). Supports the statement that 3-to-5-year-olds enjoy pretend play and invent characters because they can think symbolically.
